text.tspan: The marriage of the Lamb draws nigh
My heart, my all is Yours to fill,
May my life express Your righteousness;
The corporate bride, God’s heart’s desire;
We give all and race desperately;
A fearsome army, one with God;
At her banners, foes flee away;
More than conqu’rors, spread to all the earth,
Build God’s kingdom, and turn the age.
